headline: Elite Grup buys Sanex platform in Cluj for 40 million euros and prepares to repurpose a 17.2-hectare industrial zone Saptamana Financiara
summary: Elite Grup is taking over the Sanex platform in Cluj for 40 million euros. The company is preparing to repurpose a 17.2-hectare industrial zone.
why: Industrial real estate deals and site repurposing shape property values and development pipelines in Romanian regional cities.
